keys: agentwork.testkeys public test keys alice (payer), bob (worker), carol (checker)

scenarios.name: settled-then-refunded
scenarios.note: refund names the settled receipt: voids it

scenarios.name: dispute-then-settle
scenarios.note: dispute suspends, a new settled receipt with a fresh attest restores

scenarios.name: stale-correction
scenarios.note: refund names the first receipt, not the tip (dispute): ignored

scenarios.name: future-correction
scenarios.note: refund dated after the evaluation time is not yet current

scenarios.name: restore-needs-fresh-attest
scenarios.note: re-settle without its own attest is current but does not count

scenarios.name: duplicate-delivery
scenarios.note: every line delivered twice: dedup by cid, same result as settled-then-refunded

scenarios.name: out-of-order-delivery
scenarios.note: dispute-then-settle lines arrive newest first: order is by (ts, cid), not arrival

scenarios.name: backdated-correction
scenarios.note: refund names the settled receipt but is dated before it: ignored

scenarios.name: settle-after-dispute-must-link
scenarios.note: settled after a dispute that names the original, not the dispute: stale, stays disputed

scenarios.name: fork-earliest-wins
scenarios.note: two corrections name the same tip: the earlier (ts, cid) continues the chain, the other is ignored
